scripts.dev:agent: cd agent && uv run uvicorn draw.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: npm --prefix web test && cd agent && uv run pytest
scripts.lint: npm --prefix web run lint && cd agent && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && cd agent && uv run mypy .
scripts.gen:schemas: npm --prefix web run gen:types && cd agent && uv run python scripts/gen_schemas.py
scripts.check:schemas: npm run gen:schemas && git diff --exit-code -- web/types/schemas.ts agent/draw/schemas.py && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- web/types/schemas.ts agent/draw/schemas.py)"
